verdict.rationale: Windmill's AI generation docs describe a built-in AI that edits workspace items. The user can then ask it to review those changes, and it opens the Compare & Deploy page with the edited items preselected, which is in-product task delegation. AI Agent flow steps and the MCP server are separate capabilities (a flow building block and an external-client integration) and are not credited here. Missing for 10: detailed docs on the range of tasks the assistant can take on, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product

citations.quote: Once the AI has edited items, ask it to review the changes and it opens the Compare & Deploy page with exactly those items preselected, ready to deploy.
